author: xLegendC
body:
• Was my temp-ban or ban really false? Yes
  • Do I have any evidence to show the staff if was false? No
  • Have I waited long enough to be un-banned? Yes
  • Have I been caught ban evading? Apparently according to Fluenza, Yes.
  • Have I appealed a ban before? No
  • Alright, so my cousin's account (Relaxed_) got banned for spamming and disrespectful and I have access to that account. I didn't use that account the past 3 days but apparently according to Fluenza, I did. Furthermore, he ban me for ban evading when my cousin's ban time was already over.

title: Ban dispute for xLegendC

replies.author: Administrafer
replies.body:
Hi,
You clearly claimed your cousin does not live with you, and that he/she hadn't visited your house during the punishment of the account Relaxed_ (I have chat logs of you saying this). Then, I checked the IP session logs of both accounts, and it appears that xLegendC has logged into the same IP that Relaxed was on at the time of the ban; 54 times. 

You will not be appealed; and lying does not help your cause. 
Thanks.
